content:
marie: Quick sync — final prod-entry checklist. Need decisions on: SLA tiers, docs scope, support handoff, monitoring alert thresholds, and pricing exceptions for pilot customers. Who can own which bullet? Meeting in 1h if needed.

raj: I can own SLA perf testing + latency SLOs. Need clarity on percentile targets and whether dedicated has separate targets.

taylor: Ops can own monitoring + alerting runbook. Quick Q: do we keep current SLOs (p99 < 300ms hosted) or tighten to what product asked for? cc @marie

marie: For hosted API target p99 <= 250ms for GA. Dedicated customers can have documented higher tails. We also need a short docs section "expected latency by tier".

elena: Support will own the incident playbook and escalation flow. Need oncall rota + training doc. Also, will pilot customers get SLA credits or exceptions?

sam: FinOps: pricing exceptions ok for up to 3 pilot accounts for up to 3 months but we need signed OK and clear economic assumptions. I'll draft the comms blurb for sales.

raj: For perf tests I'll spin up a canary harness. One decision: do we permit unvetted quant profiles for dedicated GA or only vetted profiles?

marie: Only vetted quant profiles for GA. Experimental/opt-in flag allowed for users who explicitly accept support limits. Not GA-supported.

taylor: Ops note: autoscale burst policy needs a guardrail. Proposal: burst to 2x reserved capacity for up to 10 minutes, then shed to protect latency. Thoughts?

elena: Support + SRE: sounds reasonable. Need to document the user-facing behavior — which error codes on throttle (429?) vs infra fallback (503). We'll draft examples.

sam: Also ensure billing shows "throttled" events and any token refund policy. Customers will ask.

marie: Action items recap: raj owns perf SLO doc + canary (EOD), taylor owns monitoring runbook + alert thresholds (tomorrow), elena owns support playbook + training checklist (3 days), sam owns pricing-exceptions + commercial note (EOD). I'll collate and send to leads.

raj: ack. I'll post canary link when up: https://ci.internal/redwood/perf-canary (placeholder).

deploy-bot: New canary pipeline created by raj — pipeline/1704321999 started.

marie: Thanks all. If no blockers, we aim to greenlight prod entry for the initial cohort by EOW :rocket:
